shows.title: 25th Anniversary Exhibition
shows.summary: The Neue Galerie New York is hosting an exhibition celebrating its 25th anniversary, featuring works from its collection.

shows.title: Austrian Masterworks
shows.summary: The Neue Galerie New York is showcasing Austrian masterworks from its collection, with an exhibition that will continue beyond January 13, 2027.

shows.title: 1910: Portrait of a Year
shows.summary: The Neue Galerie New York is presenting an exhibition titled '1910: Portrait of a Year', focusing on the year 1910 and its cultural significance.
